observation_policy: Improved: triangulated automatic body plus WiLoR wrist/MCP, full covariance, group means. Legacy: all original 2D points. No nose or edge deletion.
selection: At each predeclared budget choose minimum feasible training objective only; no GT selection.
purpose: Factorial shape/pose initialization comparison with one shared seed-independent objective.
shape_prior: weight * mean(betas ** 2), centered at zero model shape; isotropic regularizer, not device-calibrated population covariance
template: All 21 local body axis angles zero; mean model beta. Same zero hand/face parameters and foot local rotations in all groups.
pose_prior: Common weak zero-centered axis-angle regularizer, normalized by broad absolute caps. Engineering regularizer, not a learned anatomical density.
initial_root: Set root rotation/translation so native Head exactly matches the same supplied full Head anchor; no network root is read.
fixed_parameters: Zero hand/face inputs, preserving the external SMPL-X layer hand-mean convention. L_Foot/R_Foot local rotations fixed to zero.
convergence: Report loss and accepted-point displacement over final 1000 steps; relative loss decrease <0.001 and max target-joint displacement <0.1 mm is a diagnostic flag, not a global optimum proof.
